, McCorkle Research Facility lobby
The beautiful morning was already morphing into a muggy summer day as Rand approached the main entrance to the McCorkle Research Facility. An architect had cladded the front elevation with precast glass panels that changed their hues with the movement of the sun, projecting splashes of color onto the sidewalks below.
